We don't have actual confirmation input from user. We'll assume they want us to perform steps automatically. So step 1: display doors status. Step 2: If all closed, then start engine. Since we can't interactively ask, we'll just attempt to lock doors anyway. Or better: Use lockDoors to ensure they're locked. Let's lock all four doors. Then start engine.

Thus sequence:

Call lockDoors({unlock:false, door:["driver","passenger","rear_left","rear_right"]})

Then startEngine({ignitionMode:"START"})

But also might want to display status. Could combine. I'll output calls accordingly.
